description.value: In this review, we focus on DMN suppression and its functional role in health and disease, summarizing evidence that spans several disciplines, including cognitive neuroscience, pharmacological neuroimaging, clinical neuroscience, and theoretical neuroscience.

spans.text: In this review, we focus on DMN suppression and its functional role in health and disease, summarizing evidence that spans several disciplines, including cognitive neuroscience, pharmacological neuroimaging, clinical neuroscience, and theoretical neuroscience.

description.value: This review draws on multiple complementary approaches, including cognitive and systems neuroscience, electrophysiology, clinical neuroscience, computational neuroscience, and emerging pharmaco-fMRI studies.
